question: Which divine beings inhabit the levels above the person in niyati and time?
premises: Above the person, in niyati, there are ten Shankaras.
Those Shankaras are described as golden-colored and very white.
In the principle of time there are ten Shivas.
inference: The levels above the person are inhabited by ten Shankaras in niyati and ten Shivas in time.
uncertainties: The verse gives appearance details for the Shankaras but not for the Shivas.
plain_english: Above the person, in niyati, dwell ten Shankaras, golden and very white. In the principle of time dwell ten Shivas.
